title: ClickPaid
tagline: Creators upload, community votes on most clickable thumbnails, and wins ETH bounties. Incentivized engagement for creators, voters, and maximum visibility

prizes.placement: Build the next big consumer crypto app
prizes.title: Build the next big consumer crypto app

description:
ClickPaid is an innovative platform designed to help YouTube content creators enhance their video engagement by optimizing their thumbnails through community participation. The core idea behind ClickPaid is to eliminate the guesswork for creators when it comes to choosing the most clickable thumbnail for their videos.

Creators on ClickPaid can either upload their own thumbnails or utilize AI tools provided by the platform to generate potential options. Once these thumbnails are available, the community steps in to vote on which one they find most appealing and likely to attract viewers. This approach ensures that the chosen thumbnail is not just a matter of personal preference but is backed by collective feedback from a diverse audience.

To incentivize participation, YouTubers set a bounty reward for each vote cast on their thumbnails. This reward is distributed in ETH (Ethereum cryptocurrency), turning the voting process into a financially rewarding experience for participants. As a result, voters are motivated to contribute their opinions, knowing that their input has tangible benefits.

For creators, this means that they can confidently select the thumbnail that has been validated by the community, increasing the likelihood of higher click-through rates and improved video performance. ClickPaid effectively bridges the gap between content creation and viewer engagement, making it a valuable tool for anyone looking to maximize their content's impact.

Currently, ClickPaid is deployed on several test networks including OP Sepolia, Base Sepolia, Mode Testnet, and Metal L2 Testnet. This multi-network deployment allows us to test and refine our platform's functionality in various environments, ensuring robust performance and scalability.

By integrating a community-driven approach with financial incentives, ClickPaid transforms the process of thumbnail selection into a collaborative and rewarding experience for both creators and voters.
how_its_made:
ClickPaid is a cutting-edge platform built using a range of advanced technologies to ensure seamless functionality and user engagement. At the core of our backend, we've developed smart contracts that are deployed across multiple blockchain networks, including OP Sepolia, Base Sepolia, Mode Testnet, and Metal L2 Testnet. This multi-chain approach enables us to manage rewards and payouts efficiently on various platforms, providing broad access and flexibility for users.

To address the challenge of bot interference and ensure that only genuine users participate, we have implemented WorldCoin Verification. This verification system is a significant enhancement for our platform, helping to maintain the integrity of the voting process and ensuring that votes are cast by real, authenticated users.

In addition, we use Pyth Network’s price feeds for converting ETH to USD. This integration allows us to offer accurate, real-time currency conversion, making the rewards system more transparent and understandable for users. We also leverage Pyth Network’s random number generation in our unique algorithm, which helps determine the visibility of posts.

For the frontend and on-chain interactions, we utilize ThirdWeb UI and its hooks to create an intuitive user interface, while also employing Web3.js for specific blockchain interactions. This combination ensures a smooth and interactive user experience.

Finally, our smart contracts are deployed and verified using Foundry, and their status can be tracked on BlockScout Explorer. This ensures that our contracts are both secure and transparent, reinforcing trust in our platform.

By integrating these technologies, ClickPaid provides a robust and reliable platform that enhances content visibility and engagement while ensuring the integrity and fairness of the voting process.
